title: Pass0 has a bottom-tested entry and narrow scroll counters
claim: Recovery interprets Pass0 as one-pixel vertical scrolling with row refills at eight-pixel boundaries. An initial jump to 0x0800FC94 reproduces the entry branch. Truncations support unsigned 16-bit counters; clip bounds are signed halfwords. Recheck these historical observations before writing shared headers.

claim: A linker-assigned clip-span symbol historically produced the desired signed-load form. The spilled destination base is reused in r7 within the upward copy loop; spilling alone does not imply volatility. These improvements did not produce a matching function.
